scenario: The ego vehicle swerves to avoid a stationary adversarial vehicle and a temporary obstacle in its lane.

ego.behavior: The car travels forward, then swerves left into the adjacent lane to avoid obstacles ahead, and continues forward.

adversarials.behavior: The car remains stationary in the ego's original lane directly ahead of the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: On a two-lane straight road, the ego vehicle starts in the right lane behind a stationary adversarial car, with a temporary obstacle positioned immediately behind the stationary adversarial car in the same lane.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must maintain sufficient initial distance from the stationary adversarial car to perform an avoidance maneuver; the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle has passed the obstacle and returned to a stable forward trajectory.

road_side_structures.position: Located on the roadside beyond the stationary adversarial car, on the right side of the road.

temporary_modifications.position: Placed directly behind the stationary adversarial car in the center of the ego vehicle's original lane.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the left car with dashed trajectory; the right car is stationary adversarial. 2. Enumeration: one adversarial car. 3. Chronology: initial ego approaches stationary car; midpoint ego swerves left; ending ego passes in adjacent lane. 4. Evidence: dashed arrow shows lateral deviation; black square indicates lane obstacle; tree marks roadside beyond.
